text: むこうに　うみの　うえを　とおる　ながーい　みちが　みえる！

structure.jp: うみの　うえを　とおる

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: うみの　うえを　とおる　ながーい　みち
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed before a thing tells you which thing it is. うみの　うえを　とおる　ながーい　みち = 'a looong road that passes over the sea'.

patterns.name: 〜を (path)
patterns.explanation: を with a verb of moving shows the place you move through or across. うえを　とおる = 'pass over the top'.

patterns.name: 〜がみえる
patterns.explanation: みえる means something comes into view by itself, and the thing seen takes が, not を. みちが　みえる = 'I can see a road'.
